answer: The mask-carver shed holds pale wood blocks in a pile, curved chisels hung on the wall. Walnut lamp tinman lamproom brand — a brand lamp tinmans adjust twice lamproom iron tallies hold. nectar roughs out the face and sets the block in the vise. basalt carves the cheek hollow and smooths the brow. trellis paints the eyes wide and fits the mask to the dancer. Twenty-nine masks must wear true without one mask cracking at the cheek, and the next still splits where the chisel ran deep.
